summary: Cohere evaluation/trial API keys are free but limited: 1,000 API calls per month, and Chat models at 20 requests per minute. Production keys are paid with higher limits. Create a trial or production key on the API keys page. This reactivates the previously archived cohere-trial-key listing. The rate-limits page does not state a non-commercial restriction.
claim_steps: Sign up at dashboard.cohere.com (no card mentioned for trial keys).
Open the API keys page and create a Trial (evaluation) key.
Stay within 1,000 API calls/month and Chat 20 req/min trial limits.

social_proof.title: Different Types of API Keys and Rate Limits | Cohere
social_proof.text: Cohere offers two kinds of API keys: evaluation keys (free but limited in usage), and production keys. Trial keys are limited to 1,000 API calls a month. Chat API trial rate limit: 20 req / min.
